_meta.spec: OVCA_Decision_Engine_Spec_v0.1 §6 task 1, extended to the clear cell, endometrioid and mucinous notes
_meta.hard_rule_3: Unreported fields are the literal string "not_reported". No estimation, no inference, no carry-over from model knowledge of the trial. Where a source reports grade 3 and grade 4 separately and never sums them, the field is "not_reported" and the split is given in notes.
_meta.coverage: Trials cited by the histotype-specific regimen records in data/regimens_occc.json, regimens_oec.json and regimens_moc.json that are not already in data/tox.json. Regimens shared with HGSC (carboplatin–paclitaxel, carboplatin–PLD, PLD, weekly paclitaxel, bevacizumab combinations, PARP inhibitors, T-DXd, KEYNOTE-B96, ROSELLA) keep their HGSC tox_ref: the toxicity of a regimen is read from the trial that reported it, whatever the histology mix.
_meta.field_conventions: As data/tox.json. grade3plus_any_pct is the ANY-CAUSE grade ≥3 rate per arm where printed; treatment_related_grade3plus_pct carries a TRAE-only figure.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: irinotecan 60 D1,8,15 + cisplatin 60 D1 q4w ×6 (CPT-P) vs paclitaxel 175 + carboplatin AUC 6 q3w ×6 (TC)
signature_ae: TC: G3/4 neutropenia 90.2%, thrombocytopenia 14.2%, sensory neuropathy 7.4%, arthralgia/myalgia
CPT-P: G3/4 diarrhoea 7.8%, nausea 10.0%, vomiting 7.8%, anorexia 7.2%, febrile neutropenia 6.9%
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: stopped chemotherapy early: TC 26% (86/325), CPT-P 28% (92/321); completed 6 cycles 73.5% vs 71.3%
table_histotype_trials.notes: No treatment-related deaths. Per-AE grade 3/4 rates printed per arm; the paper never sums to an any-grade-≥3 figure, so grade3plus_any_pct stays not_reported. Asterisked AEs differed between arms at P<.05.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: durvalumab 1500 mg q4w vs physician's-choice chemotherapy (2:1)
signature_ae: chemotherapy arm: G3/4 neutropenia 25.0%, anaemia 12.5%, thrombocytopenia 6.2%, mucositis 6.2%
durvalumab: irAEs of interest 45.2%; G3/4 hyponatraemia, rash, amylase, hypomagnesaemia 3.2% each
QoL: less constipation, neuropathy and hair loss with durvalumab
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: TRAE leading to discontinuation 0 in both arms
table_histotype_trials.notes: No treatment-related deaths. Randomised phase 2, n=47 treated; chemotherapy arm = paclitaxel, PLD, gemcitabine or topotecan by physician choice.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: nivolumab 3 mg/kg + ipilimumab 1 mg/kg q3w ×4 → nivolumab 480 mg q4w (single arm)
table_histotype_trials.treatment_related_grade3plus_pct: immune-related AEs grade ≥3 in 35% (10/28); text: 9 (35%) grade 3–4 plus 1 grade 5
signature_ae: ONE TREATMENT-RELATED DEATH: immune-mediated myocarditis with ventricular arrhythmia after 3 doses
3 patients switched to nivolumab alone after irAEs during induction
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: 3/28 (7% per text; 11% by count) stopped the combination for irAEs; 14 (54%) completed all 4 induction doses
table_histotype_trials.notes: Only immune-related AE rates are printed; an all-cause grade ≥3 rate is not.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: sintilimab 200 mg + bevacizumab 15 mg/kg q3w (single arm)
signature_ae: grade 3 TRAEs 3/41: proteinuria, myocarditis, rash (1 each)
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: treatment-related SAE 2 (5%): immune-related myocarditis led to discontinuation; AE-related interruption 12%
table_histotype_trials.notes: CTCAE v5. All-Chinese single-arm phase 2, n=41 safety set; 68% platinum-resistant.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: pembrolizumab 200 mg q3w + lenvatinib 20 mg daily (single arm)
signature_ae: oral mucositis 41%, anorexia 44%, fatigue 44%, diarrhoea 37%, proteinuria 30%, hypothyroidism 30%
table_histotype_trials.dose_reduction_pct: lenvatinib dose modification used for toxicity management (rate not printed)

signature_ae: G3 ALT increase and hyperthyroidism 4% each
immune-related hepatitis, encephalitis, ketoacidosis, AKI 2% each
table_histotype_trials.dose_reduction_pct: not applicable (no dose reduction for pembrolizumab)

table_histotype_trials.regimen: nivolumab 240 mg q2w + ipilimumab 1 mg/kg q6w, continuous (single arm)
table_histotype_trials.notes: No treatment-related deaths. Reduced-dose ipilimumab schedule (1 mg/kg q6w) vs MoST-CIRCUIT's 1 mg/kg q3w ×4.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: 2×2 factorial: oxaliplatin 130 + capecitabine 850 BID D1–14 q3w ×6 vs carboplatin AUC 5/6 + paclitaxel 175 q3w ×6, each ± bevacizumab 15 mg/kg (+12 maintenance cycles)
signature_ae: Pac-Carbo: G3–4 neutropenia 5/13, thrombocytopenia 2/13, sensory neuropathy 2/13
Oxal-Cape-Bev: hypertension 6/13, diarrhoea 3/13, hand-foot 2/13, bleeding 2/13, GI perforation 1/13
alopecia any grade 83% with paclitaxel vs 23% without
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: 40/50 completed 6 chemotherapy cycles; 10/23 completed 12 bevacizumab maintenance cycles
table_histotype_trials.notes: CTCAE v4.0. Arms of 11–13 patients: the rates are counts, not estimates. Trial stopped at 50/330 for poor accrual.

table_histotype_trials.regimen: carboplatin AUC 7.5 + paclitaxel 175 q3w: 3 vs 6 cycles
signature_ae: G3–4 neurotoxicity 2% (3 cycles) vs 11% (6 cycles), P<0.01
two possibly treatment-related deaths (cardiac arrest cycle 2; ARDS after cycle 2)
one MDS in the 3-cycle arm after further chemotherapy for recurrence
table_histotype_trials.notes: GOG toxicity criteria, not CTCAE; grades 2/3/4 printed separately per category and never summed.
n=233 across 27 tumour types; ovarian cohort ORR 33.3% (5/15), median PFS 2.3 mo.

table_histotype_trials.histology: ER/PR-positive recurrent ovarian cancer with CA125-only progression (endometrioid n=4)
signature_ae: mostly grade 1 fatigue, hot flushes, arthralgia
other G3 events (vomiting 3, nausea 2, anorexia 1) judged disease-related
table_histotype_trials.discontinuation_pct: 2 patients stopped for treatment-related AEs (arthralgia, headache, hot flushes)
table_histotype_trials.source: GO_summaries/2019_Kok_PARAGON Anastrozole ER-PR+ Ovarian CA125 Progression.md
table_histotype_trials.notes: n=54. QoL global health fell 3.7 points (small change).
